PetDoc teleclinic: data flow & key patterns

1,413 consultations · Aug 2025 – Jan 2026 · prepared for Paarmita Bhargava

1. Alluvial flow

Read left to right. Each ribbon is a group of consultations; green ribbons returned within 180 days. Friction-free consultations feed the thick green stream; friction ribbons turn mostly grey.

2. Data flow map

How the dataset is built, and where selection bias enters: ratings and comments are opt-in.

3. Friction stacks up

Follow-up falls from 26% with no friction to ~1% with two issues. Ratings fall in step.

4. Which friction matters

Video/audio issues and restarts are the strongest retention killers; a vet re-asking known info is milder (17% follow-up) but twice as frequent as audio issues.

5. Who returns

Chronic cases return most (48%) by nature. Rating predicts follow-up: 5-star 34% vs 1-3 star ≤11%.

6. Wait and delivery thresholds

Both are threshold effects: follow-up drops from ~23% to 16% beyond a 15 min wait, and from ~26% to 16% beyond 4 days delivery.

7. Comment themes

Re-telling the story is the top complaint theme and ties to the context-handover idea.

8. Time trend

Context only. Follow-up for late months is incomplete because of the 180-day window.
